name: D09_1_search_takes_exactly_one_creature_with_mana_value_6_or_more
notes: Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library for a creature card with mana value 6 or greater, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.' My library holds creatures of mana value 6 and 7, a creature of mana value 5, and a mana value 6 sorcery; the opponent's library holds a mana value 8 creature. I take the may and the search offers only the two creatures of mana value 6 or more (the mana value 5 creature and the sorcery are not offered). I take the mana value 6 one: exactly that one card goes to my hand; the other three stay in my library; the opponent's library is untouched and in its original order.
